summary.zh-Hans: 吉隆坡双子塔以一座双层空中连桥连接两座塔楼。
summary.en: A double-decker skybridge connects the two PETRONAS Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur.

summary.zh-Hans: KLCC 公园有绿地、带图案的步道、长椅和遮蔽休息处，也设有跑步道与儿童游乐区。
summary.en: KLCC Park has greenery, patterned footpaths, benches and shelters, as well as a jogging track and a children’s play area.

summary.zh-Hans: 椰浆饭用椰奶和香兰叶煮饭，常搭配参巴酱、黄瓜、炸小鱼、花生和蛋。
summary.en: Nasi lemak uses rice cooked with coconut milk and pandan leaves, often served with sambal, cucumber, fried anchovies, peanuts and egg.

summary.zh-Hans: Roti canai 是马来西亚的面饼，可以搭配咖喱，也有加入香蕉等甜馅的版本。
summary.en: Roti canai is a Malaysian bread that can accompany curry, with sweet versions including banana fillings as well.
